reason: The money is nothing, 1,500 a month I would not even notice. But I run my competition night on a whiteboard now and it works, and I am the one who will end up standing there fiddling with a phone instead of working the floor.
objection: Who actually operates it on the night? My boys will not learn a new app, and if it goes wrong mid-tournament with twenty people watching the screen, I look like a fool and I am back to the whiteboard anyway.
would_change_my_mind: Someone comes to my venue, sets it up on my screen themselves, and runs one night standing next to my floor staff so I see them do it without me touching anything.
